story.fullStory:
No Doubt's "Underneath It All" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Underneath It All" is a song by American rock band No Doubt, released in July 2002 as the third single from their fourth studio album, Rock Steady (2001).

"Underneath It All" is a song by American rock band No Doubt, released in July 2002 as the third single from their fourth studio album, Rock Steady (2001).
Written by the band's lead singer Gwen Stefani and David Stewart, the song features a reggae production from Sly and Robbie and guest vocals from Lady Saw.
The song received mixed reviews from contemporary music critics and became No Doubt's highest-charting US single, but it was less successful elsewhere.
Rock Steady is the fifth studio album by American rock band No Doubt, released on December 11, 2001, by Interscope Records.
The band began writing the album with initial recording sessions in Los Angeles and San Francisco, then traveled to London and Jamaica to work with various performers, songwriters, and producers.
Sly & Robbie, the Neptunes, and William Orbit were among the many artists the band collaborated with on the album.
No Doubt is an American rock band formed in Anaheim, California in 1986.
